options.en: He is standing next to a desk.
He is sitting in front of a screen.
He is sitting behind a desk.
The librarian is writing on a card.
options.zh: 圖書館員正在一張卡片上寫字。

options.en: The teacher is sitting with the students.
The students are standing by the window.
The students are writing on the board.
options.zh: 學生們正在黑板上寫字。

options.en: The teacher is standing in front of the class.
She is sitting in a chair with a magazine.
options.zh: 她拿著雜誌坐在椅子上。

options.en: She is standing under a lamp.

fills.en: I have ___ in this town since August.
fills.zh: 我從八月起就住在這個小鎮。
fills.note: have 加過去分詞 lived，是現在完成式，和 since 一起用。

fills.en: Please write your ___ on the last page of the form.
fills.zh: 請在表格的最後一頁簽名。
fills.note: signature 是簽名；其他是薪水、餘額、估價。

fills.en: You can ___ a library book if no one else is waiting for it.
fills.zh: 如果沒有別人在等，你可以續借圖書館的書。
fills.note: renew 是續借；repair 是修理，replace 是更換，remember 是記得。

fills.en: My interview is ___ ten o'clock on Tuesday.
fills.zh: 我的面試在星期二十點。
fills.note: 幾點幾分用 at；星期幾用 on。

fills.en: The bank charges a small ___ for each transfer.
fills.zh: 銀行每次轉帳都會收一筆小額手續費。
fills.note: fee 是手續費；wage 是工資，skill 是技能，degree 是學位。

fills.en: If you need help with your resume, the counselor will be happy ___ you.
fills.zh: 如果你的履歷需要幫忙，輔導員會很樂意幫你。
fills.note: be happy to 加原形動詞：很樂意做某事。

fills.en: The mechanic said my old tires were ___, so I bought new ones.
fills.zh: 技師說我的舊輪胎很危險，所以我買了新的。
fills.note: dangerous 是危險的；patient 有耐心的，formal 正式的，quiet 安靜的。

fills.en: She ___ her first draft yet, so she can't send it.
fills.zh: 她還沒寫完初稿，所以還不能寄出去。
fills.note: yet 常和現在完成式 hasn't 加過去分詞 finished 一起用。

fills.en: Classes at the community center ___ in September.
fills.zh: 社區中心的課九月開始。
fills.note: 主詞 Classes 是複數，動詞用 begin。

fills.en: I'd like to ___ some cash into my account.
fills.zh: 我想把一些現金存進我的帳戶。
fills.note: deposit 是存款；borrow 借，spend 花，charge 收費。

fills.en: The manager asked me ___ a little early for the interview.
fills.zh: 經理請我面試時早一點到。
fills.note: ask 某人 to 加原形動詞：請某人做某事。

fills.en: Please be ___ in the library. People are studying.
fills.zh: 在圖書館裡請保持安靜，大家正在讀書。
fills.note: quiet 是安靜的；casual 隨性的，proud 驕傲的，available 有空的。

fills.en: My car makes a strange ___ when I drive fast.
fills.zh: 我開快車時，車子會發出奇怪的聲音。
fills.note: make a sound 是發出聲音；speed 速度，tire 輪胎，safety 安全。

fills.en: He works ___ than the other employees, but he is more careful.
fills.zh: 他做事比其他員工慢，但他比較細心。
fills.note: 有 than 要用比較級；slow 的比較級是 slower。

fills.en: This job requires two years of ___ in an office.
fills.zh: 這份工作需要兩年的辦公室經驗。
fills.note: experience 是經驗；opinion 意見，attention 注意力，impression 印象。

fills.en: I ___ my resume to three companies last week.
fills.zh: 我上星期把履歷寄給了三家公司。
fills.note: last week 是過去的時間，用過去式 sent；have sent 不和 last week 一起用。

question.en: How much does it cost to print four pages in color?
question.zh: 彩色列印四頁要多少錢？

question.en: What is true about the job?
question.zh: 關於這份工作，何者正確？

signs.heading: ATM Fees

question.en: What is true for people with this bank's card?
question.zh: 持有這家銀行卡片的人，何者正確？

options: They pay nothing to use the ATM.

question.en: When does the computer class meet?

passages.title: Free Resume Workshop
lines: Do you need help writing a resume in English?
Join our free workshop at the Oak Street Community Center on Saturday, July 12, from 1:00 to 3:00 p.m.
A job counselor will explain how to describe your skills and experience.
Please bring a copy of your resume if you have one. Only 15 people can join, so register at the front desk by July 10.

questions.en: What will people learn at the workshop?
questions.zh: 參加研習的人會學到什麼？
options: How to become a job counselor
How to talk about what they can do
How to make a copy of a resume

questions.en: What should people do by July 10?
questions.zh: 大家要在七月十日前做什麼？
options: Sign up at the front desk

passages.title: From: Daniel Grant
lines: Hi Ms. Ortiz,
A plumber will do some repairs in all the apartments on Wednesday, March 5. The water will be off from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
Please fill some bottles with water the night before.
If you see any water on your floor after 1:00, call me right away at 555-0148. Thank you.

questions.en: What will happen on Wednesday morning?
questions.zh: 星期三早上會發生什麼事？
options: The water will be turned off.
Mr. Grant will come to every apartment.
The water will be off all day.
Ms. Ortiz will get a new floor.

questions.en: What should Ms. Ortiz do on Tuesday night?
questions.zh: Ortiz 女士星期二晚上應該做什麼？

passages.title: Weekend Job at Green Valley Coffee Shop
lines: We are looking for a friendly person to work at the counter on weekends.
Hours: Saturday and Sunday, 7:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
Pay: $16 an hour. No experience is needed. We will teach you everything.
To apply, email your resume to Amy Fox before June 20.

questions.en: What is true about the job?
questions.zh: 關於這份工作，何者正確？
options: You work five days a week.
You don't need to have done this work before.
By coming to the shop at 7:00

passages.title: From: Kevin Shaw
lines: Hi Mei, this is Kevin from the office. Welcome to the team!
Tomorrow, please come up to Room 702. Don't wait in the lobby.
Our manager, Ms. Hill, has a meeting at 9:00, so I'll show you around first.
Lunch is at 12:30. We usually eat together at the coffee shop across the street.
See you at 8:45!

questions.en: Why won't Ms. Hill meet Mei first?
questions.zh: Hill 女士為什麼不會先和 Mei 見面？
options: She will be busy at a meeting.

passages.title: New Hours at Riverside Library
lines: Starting May 1, the library will open one hour earlier, at 9:00 a.m., Monday to Saturday. It will still close at 8:00 p.m.
On Sundays, it will be open from 12:00 to 5:00 p.m.
The computer room will be closed on Monday mornings for cleaning.
You can return books 24 hours a day in the box by the front door.

questions.en: What time did the library open on Mondays before May 1?
questions.zh: 五月一日以前，圖書館星期一幾點開門？

questions.en: What is true about the computer room?
options: It is open 24 hours a day.
People can't use it on Monday mornings.
It closes at 5:00 p.m. every day.
It is next to the front door.

passages.title: From: Lakeside Bank
lines: Hi Mr. Lin,
Thank you for opening an account with us. Your new bank card will arrive by mail in five to seven days.
When it arrives, please call 555-0172 to choose a password.
Until then, you can take out cash at the counter with your passport.
There is no fee each month if you keep at least $500 in your account.

questions.en: What should Mr. Lin do when the card arrives?
questions.zh: 卡片寄到時，林先生應該做什麼？

questions.en: When does Mr. Lin not have to pay a fee each month?
questions.zh: 林先生在什麼情況下不用付月費？
options: When he pays $500 to the bank
When he keeps $500 or more in his account
When he takes out cash at the counter

passages.title: English Practice Night
lines: Want to practice your English? Join our English Practice Night at the Pine Hill Community Center!
We meet every Thursday from 6:30 to 8:00 p.m. in Room 204.
Each week, our volunteer teacher, Mr. Ruiz, chooses something new to talk about, like shopping or job interviews.
Members pay $10 a month. Your first night is free.

options: Mr. Ruiz teaches a computer class.

questions.en: How much does it cost to come the first time?

passages.title: From: Grace Kim (job counselor)
lines: Hi Tomas, I have good news. The people at Bayview Trading want to interview you for the front desk job.
The interview is on Friday at 2:00 p.m. with the manager, Mr. Evans.
Please bring two copies of your resume. You don't need to wear a suit, but please look nice.
Let me know if Friday doesn't work for you.

questions.en: What job did Tomas apply for?
questions.zh: Tomas 應徵的是什麼工作？

questions.en: What should Tomas bring to the interview?
questions.zh: Tomas 面試時應該帶什麼？
